Rose Clinic Performance Physiotherapy, a private practice based in London. We are committed to delivering high-standard, evidence-based treatment for a wide range of musculoskeletal and neurological, including sports injuries and work-related disorders.

Award-winning practice "Quality Assured Clinic (QAC)"

We provide expert second opinions/ professional advice on:
	•	Low back pain, sciatica, and discopathy
	•	Joint conditions 
	•	Neck pain, postural issues
	•	Gait abnormalities 
. Shockwave: MASTERPLUS SHOCKWAVE THERAPY

. Foot Scan and 3D Orthotic Insoles

All our practitioners are HCPC, Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP), registered and part of Physio First
Our YouTube channel is a trusted resource for patients, students, and clinicians.
